portfolio_description: Shared lists for getting things done together. Create lists, assign tasks to members, and collaborate in real-time.
portfolio_body: Listly is a collaborative task list PWA for couples, roommates, and small teams. Create multiple lists, share them by email, assign items to specific members with colored initials, and set a draggable 'today' line to prioritize what matters now. Real-time sync via Supabase means everyone sees changes instantly. Built with Google OAuth, emerald green theme, and designed as a mobile-first PWA.
